name: Equipment Solutions Inc.
old_description: In 1979, John began his career in operations by running a commissary for a local restaurant company. Prior to 1989, he managed restaurants. That year, he transitioned to the dealer or fabrication section, where he remained until 1997. He has also been in the manufacturer’s representative business since 1997 and is a principal with ESI.
about:
Equipment Solutions Inc. (ESI) was established in 1997 in Sterling, Virginia. John Coates, a principal with the company, had been active in the manufacturer's representative business since that year after a career in restaurant operations and management.

The company operates as a manufacturer's representative and distributor of foodservice equipment, smallwares, and tabletop products, partnering with national and international brands. It also collaborates with its sister company, Hospitality Solutions Group, to supply indoor and outdoor furniture and shade solutions. ESI maintains a centrally located facility in the Loudoun Commerce Center that includes a showroom, a fully equipped test kitchen, demonstration space, a training area, and a warehouse. The facility sits five miles from Dulles Airport and Reston Town Center.

ESI serves foodservice professionals across Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Its customers include manufacturers, designers, consultants, franchise organizations, educational institutions, and independent restaurant and hospitality operators. The company works on projects of every scale, from single-location upgrades to multi-unit rollouts.

The company emphasizes knowledgeable guidance, responsive service, and a hands-on approach that lets clients test equipment in its demo kitchen before purchasing. It positions itself as a single source for equipment, smallwares, furniture, and shade, backed by decades of industry experience.
